task_candidate.input: same source video and audio window at annotated segment timestamps
task_candidate.decision: binary probability over source visible / source not visible

selected_media_smoke.selection_rule: stable SHA-256 rank over label-bearing train/valid sound segments; one unique video per visibility value per split

frozen_encoder_smokes.matched_window: same centered 2s or full annotated interval, timestamps shared between modalities
frozen_encoder_smokes.video_frame_sampling: 8 uniformly spaced target times; nearest decoded PTS
frozen_encoder_smokes.package_size_note: The .npz checkpoint is unquantized; ideal 4-bit payload estimate is not a measured package.

efficientat_feature_attempt_note.initial_run_discovery: After 63 features from 48kHz stereo WAVs, a later 44.1kHz mono PCM WAV hit an overly narrow decoder assertion. The HotUGPU child stopped before touching weights; existing feature rows were retained and hash-verified on resume.
efficientat_feature_attempt_note.correction: Decoder now supports the four observed signed 32-bit PCM format combinations; no sample IDs, labels, windows, or checkpoint changed.

matched_frozen_readout.readout: single affine binary-logit head; zero initialization; full-batch CPU LBFGS; fixed 250 max iterations; fixed L2=0.01; no early stopping or validation-based selection
matched_frozen_readout.training_log_warning: train_final_ce in the JSON is the initial zero-logit closure value returned by PyTorch LBFGS, not final train CE; use train_metrics NLL/Brier/accuracy for the fitted readout. No refit or validation tuning was performed.
